# Piemme Nord Oftalmica

> Piemme Nord Oftalmica, a brand of Piemme S.r.l., distributes and services ophthalmic equipment for eye care professionals in Northern Italy. It is an authorised dealer for Italy of SBM Sistemi (ocular surface and Dry Eye diagnostics, instruments such as the OS1000 and LUNA X) and the exclusive distributor for Northern Italy of Optopol Technology (OCT such as the REVO HR, angio-OCT and ophthalmic imaging).

The website is intended for healthcare professionals. It is available in Italian and English.

## Services

- Specialist consulting on choosing ophthalmic technologies
- Sale of selected ophthalmic equipment (SBM Sistemi, Optopol)
- Technical service: support, maintenance, repair and upgrades
- Pre-owned professional equipment: trade-in, appraisal and handling
- Training (Piemme Academy): on-site courses, demos, hands-on training on instruments and software

## Who it serves

- Ophthalmologists: advanced Dry Eye diagnosis and OCT imaging in refractive and cataract surgery, clinical management and follow-up
- Opticians and optometrists: Dry Eye and keratoconus screening in store
- Advanced aesthetic medicine: ocular wellbeing and treatments integrated with Dry Eye care

## In italiano

Piemme Nord Oftalmica, marchio di Piemme S.r.l., distribuisce e assiste strumenti oftalmici per i professionisti della visione in Nord Italia: rivenditore per l'Italia di SBM Sistemi (diagnosi del Dry Eye e della superficie oculare, strumenti come OS1000 e LUNA X) ed esclusivista per il Nord Italia di Optopol Technology (OCT come REVO HR, angio-OCT e imaging oftalmico). Offre consulenza specialistica, assistenza tecnica, gestione dell'usato professionale e formazione (Piemme Academy). Sede operativa a Sommacampagna (VR).
